ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, it is known that $S_{\triangle ABD} : S_{\triangle ACD} = 2 : 1$, point E is the midpoint of AB, and the area of $\triangle ABC$ is $9\,\text{cm}^2$. What is the area of $\triangle AED$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $S_{\triangle ABD} : S_{\triangle ACD} = 2 : 1$,\\
it follows that $S_{\triangle ACD} = \frac{1}{2}S_{\triangle ABD}$,\\
since point E is the midpoint of AB,\\
thus $S_{\triangle ADE} = S_{\triangle BDE} = \frac{1}{2}S_{\triangle ABD}$,\\
hence $S_{\triangle ADE} = \frac{1}{3}S_{\triangle ABC} = \frac{1}{3} \times 9 = \boxed{3\text{cm}^2}$.
